goal: Find and open the Wikipedia article about Python, the programming language.

method.selection: Median task-time run, all trials retained; no discarded runs.
method.trial_isolation: Fresh process, local model load and fresh headless Chromium context per trial.
method.timing_boundary: Warm model, after initial navigation/observation; all planning, decisions, text, actions, waits.
method.verification: Final article URL excluding query string and exact title, plus independent audit of saved HTML canonical URL and title.
method.limitations: Three trials per model on a changing live website, run sequentially on a shared Mac; not an isolated inference throughput benchmark.
